sarana_usage.pelangkiran: a household shrine, not a sarana: where offerings go to the pitra between ngaben and atma wedana (L994, L1963)

sarana_usage.bale_banjar: a meeting hall, not a sarana: the corpus names it only as where bale salunglung may be built (L1687)
sarana_usage.persimpangan_jalan: a place the procession passes, not a sarana: the bade is turned there (prasawya, L131) and sekar ura strewn (L2511)
sarana_usage.pelinggih: a class of shrines, not a sarana of one rite (2026-10-28)
sarana_usage.merajan_kawitan: a family temple, not a sarana: tirtha kawitan is sought there (L4103), as at merajan pusat; retyped BANGUNAN_RITUAL by the canon audit 2026-10-28

ritual_parent.mlaspas: a consecration rite for any new building or object, part of no one larger rite; its Ngaben use is its kind mlaspas kajang, part of pabersihan (L1268; canon audit 2026-10-28 moved that edge from mlaspas to mlaspas kajang)
ritual_parent.panca_yadnya: the root: the five yadnya (dewa, rsi, pitra, manusa, bhuta) are its kinds
ritual_parent.madiksa: a priest's initiation, outside the death rites; the corpus names it only among life-status rites (L1352) and files it under no yadnya
ritual_parent.ngarga_tirtha: the sulinggih's worship to make tirtha by calling down Gangga (L3794); its tirtha serves purification and the making of Tirtha Pangentas, so it is part of no single rite (canon audit 2026-10-28)
ritual_parent.ngalukat: a purification applied to banten, adegan and the like in several rites (L3679); the corpus files it under no single rite

scope.1335|tirtha|weda pengastawa: general: the passage is about tirtha's price ('berapapun harganya, tirtha itu tetap punya nilai spiritual yang sama, karena dipuja dengan weda pengastawa yang sama') -- any tirtha
scope.1468|upakara|sajen dan tirtha panglukata: general: 'upakara tersebut' (L1164) is the rite's whole set of upakara, purified before use; L3679 says the same of tirtha panglukatan 'untuk banten (upakara)'. scope.1468|upakara|tirtha panglukatan: general: as the 1468 text fact above
